# pqc-signatures-security skill

Agent skill for PQC signature operations and security boundaries.

## Purpose

- ML-DSA-65/87 and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signing and verification.
- Audit rules for banned algorithms and secrets.

## Ownership

- Local-router security team.

## Local Contracts

- No classical crypto for secrets operations.
- Fail closed on any detected secret in logs or task files.

## Work Guidance

- Apply to all identity/signing and key lifecycle events.

## Verification

- Run audit checks before merging feature branches.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
